questions.q: State what an SQL injection attack is.

markPoints.concept: entering SQL into an input box so that it is run by the database
markPoints.exemplar: Typing SQL into an input box so the database runs it.

questions.example: Typing SQL commands into an input box on a website, so that the database runs them as part of its own query.
questions.paraphrase: Entering database commands into a form field so they get executed.
questions.feedback: SQL where data was expected. The attack works because the program joins the two together without checking.
questions.revisitLabel: 1.4 Lesson 3 — Database break-in, station 3: The attack

questions.q: Explain how a website can protect itself against SQL injection.

markPoints.concept: the input is validated or sanitised before it is used
markPoints.exemplar: The input is validated before it is used in a query.

markPoints.concept: so anything that looks like SQL is rejected rather than run
accept: reject|rejected|removed|not run|refused|blocked|not executed|treated as text|as data|not as code
markPoints.exemplar: So anything that looks like SQL is rejected rather than run.

questions.example: Every input is validated and sanitised before it goes anywhere near a query, so that characters which would turn the input into SQL are stripped out or escaped and whatever the user typed is treated as data rather than as code.
questions.paraphrase: The site checks and cleans anything entered before it reaches the database, which means text that would act as a command is removed and the entry is handled purely as data.
questions.revisitLabel: 1.4 Lesson 3 — Database break-in, station 3: The attack

questions.q: Why is SQL injection dangerous even when a website holds no passwords?
options: An attacker can read, change or delete any data in the database
It overloads the server with traffic
It installs malware on every visitor's computer
It intercepts data being sent over the network
questions.feedback: Injection gives the attacker the database's own powers. Flooding is denial of service and interception is a different attack entirely.
